name: zc_probe_rect
help_rect:
x.get_skin_preview_rect() -> (out_centre=Vector2D, out_size=Vector2D) or None
WHERE THE PREVIEW WINDOW IS ON SCREEN, as a fraction of the viewport: centre and size.

So a proof can read the PIXELS INSIDE IT rather than ask the panel whether it thinks it is open. False when
the wardrobe is shut or the window has not painted yet.

Returns:
    tuple or None: 

    out_centre (Vector2D): 

    out_size (Vector2D):
help_read:
X.read_screen_rect(min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y) -> (out_mean=LinearColor, out_dark_fraction=float, out_bright_fraction=float, out_sampled=int32) or None
WHAT IS ACTUALLY ON THE SCREEN INSIDE A RECTANGLE -- read from the same back buffer the founder photographs.

FOUNDER, 2026-09-25: "The screenshot is ground truth ... PIE test the visible pixels/content of the preview
for every skin", and "my screenshots/video override a proof that says a visibly broken feature is complete."

Every wardrobe proof this project has written asked the PANEL whether it was open and the CAMERA where it
was pointing,
